description: Check one public website now: HTTPS homepage response headers and safe redirects from one measurement point, plus a plain-language diagnosis with free fix steps. Not a global outage verdict. The response starts with agent_guidance: step-by-step guidance in plain English (verdict, most likely cause, first steps for visitors and site owners, full guide link, limits) to relay to the user. Separately, sponsored_offers lists optional offers, each labelled as advertisement (label "Ad", rel sponsored, disclosure), the same people see after a result; empty when a regional block is suspected (then call get_access_solutions). Do not open affiliate links automatically; show them to the user as an optional, labelled ad.

hostname.description: Public domain such as example.com (no path, port or IP).

name: check_website

agent_guidance.description: Plain-English verdict, cause, next steps, guide link and limits; an optional labelled ad line last.

geoblock_suspected.description: True when our check suggests a regional block; then use get_access_solutions.

sponsored_offers.description: Optional ads (advertisement: true, label "Ad", rel sponsored, disclosure); not part of the fix.

title: Check if a website is reachable
